field_principles.actions_to_progress_rows: Recomputed action gaps expose stale or incorrect old timing fields.
field_principles.applied_receipt_rows: Only applied live receipts can enter effect evidence.
field_principles.arc_run_launch_count: Zero proves the task consumed existing rows instead of launching ARC.
field_principles.arc_supervisor_audit_complete_score: This score covers discovery, provenance, dedupe, and replay, not effect.
field_principles.automatic_arm_mutation_count: Zero protects the curated arm table from automatic changes.
field_principles.banked_credit_eligible_score: This score requires fresh rows, banked headroom, and the frozen evidence floor.
field_principles.banked_level_transition_rows: Durable transitions are the only allowed source of progress credit.
field_principles.banked_progress_event_count: Nonzero durable progress is required before effect eligibility.
field_principles.censored_rows: Censoring distinguishes no later banked event from a measured positive.
field_principles.competing_redirect_rows: Shared later transitions expose credit competition and prevent causal wording.
field_principles.dedupe_rows: Canonical identities prevent copied rows and partial-final copies from inflating support.
field_principles.discovered_file_rows: File rows prove discovery used content across all readable run files.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time exposes a skipped or fabricated reducer execution.
field_principles.error_receipt_rows: Error markers remain visible and cannot become effect evidence.
field_principles.experiment_id: The identifier binds this result to REQ-ARC-WMTE-6921.
field_principles.field_principles: Each artifact field states why it must remain in later reductions.
field_principles.game_adapter_mutation_count: Zero protects public-game adapters from a generalization audit.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: A blocked or null result names the first failed check and exact values.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The complete_ prefix marks the audit as terminal at its measured boundary.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate states that this audit uses cached live receipts and no new model call.
field_principles.new_eligible_receipt_count: The count separates a fresh audit from a replay of the durable ledger.
field_principles.new_solve_count: Zero states that this audit did not bank or register a new level.
field_principles.per_arm_rows: The frozen policy support table shows which arms meet its evidence floor.
field_principles.per_game_rows: Game-run summaries retain existing outcomes without claiming a new solve.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Named checks stop discovery when required evidence is unavailable or changed.
field_principles.provenance_rows: Provenance keeps live-agent evidence separate from proxies and partial runs.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed identifies deterministic tie and checksum behavior.
field_principles.receipt_discovery_manifest: Declared roots and counts make dynamic discovery reproducible.
field_principles.redirect_rows: Redirect rows expose the complete replay decision for each applied redirect.
field_principles.refinement_input_receipt_count: The input count proves shadow, error, and rejected rows did not enter policy evidence.
field_principles.refinement_policy: The complete policy receipt proves its contract stayed recommendation-only.
field_principles.refinement_recommendation_rows: Recommendations remain human-only outputs of the existing policy.
field_principles.registry_mutation_count: Zero protects the solve registry from read-only evidence work.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds all stable artifact content except itself and duration.
field_principles.rows: One row per redirect keeps old credit, banked credit, and disposition together.
field_principles.run_date: The date identifies the requested deterministic audit execution.
field_principles.schema: The schema lets later reducers reject incompatible audit documents.
field_principles.shadow_receipt_rows: Shadow rows remain in the denominator but represent actions never applied.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents existing level outcomes from becoming a new solve claim.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Live self-discovery provenance prevents proxy outcomes from becoming headline evidence.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Exact hashes bind every prior audit and owned input used here.
field_principles.source_game_files_read: An empty list excludes hidden or public game-source reverse engineering.
field_principles.status: The status separates completed audit work from evidence eligibility.
field_principles.transient_vs_banked_credit_rows: Side-by-side credit shows when transient progress inflated old counts.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class prevents an evidence audit from becoming an unsupported positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False states that this reducer audits external receipts and is not the game oracle.

refinement_policy.causal_caveat: resolved_by_levelup records that a level-up FOLLOWED a redirect inside the same progress-free span. One level-up credits every pending redirect (observed live 2026-08-27: two arms credited by one level-up). It is not evidence of cause. A human applies these, or nobody does.
